structured.answer: I'm not deciding anything. I'll ask my son or the bank. The page marked פסגות as "הזול" with 86,492 ₪ after 10 years for the same fund, and showed the big banks lower (לאומי 83,396, הפועלים 81,471, מזרחי 77,695), so I'll ask my bank whether it's taking too much.
